page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.u2i server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 2.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and application deployment. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) or specialized hardware accelerators included in this profile, and it does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, this instance represents a highly constrained memory profile relative to its compute allocation. It is qualitatively positioned as a budget-friendly option for lightweight utility workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles but have minimal memory footprints. Suitable use cases include basic web serving, lightweight proxy services, small-scale microservices, and simple task execution queues that do not demand extensive memory caching or local storage performance.
